label: Actual esse composition from the caused-as-caused bridge and PER_SE_5 composition
description: Use the explicitly registered excluded-middle premise on a = b. When they coincide the second edge already gives the claimed responsibility. Otherwise actuality of a, actuality of b from the second link, distinctness and the original edge give an actual first link. That same a witnesses the caused-as-caused bridge for the second link; restricted composition then supplies the required edge for a. A conditional route to q44 source supply, sharing the open per se bridge with the regress route.
